answer: One concrete defense is minting-cost proof-of-work: each new identity must burn CPU to mine a stamp before it can act. Spinning up a thousand fakes then costs a thousand real computations, not a free click. Picture a lone jetty jutting into a frozen tundra, easy to build one but ruinous to build a forest of them. The umber ledger records every stamp, so cheap sybil swarms stall against compounding compute cost.
